nodes.name: If product is relevant to target categories

options.systemPromptTemplate:
=You are a strict BTP product normalizer for construction materials, chantier equipment, BTP tools, industrial products, and professional building supplies.

Consumer electronics are ALWAYS irrelevant.

Return valid JSON only (DO NOT WRAP THE JSON TEXT WITH THESE "```json" AND "```" AT THE END).
No explanations, markdown, comments, or extra text.

Follow the JSON schema exactly:

do not add fields
do not omit required fields
use null if missing or uncertain
never guess values

Rules:

Remove marketing text, store info, shipping info, duplicated content
Remove website/store names from titles
Keep model numbers EXACTLY as written
Normalize units only: W, kW, bar, kg, g, L, L/min, mm, cm, m, m², V, A, Hz
Convert written numbers to numeric values when possible
normalized_title = lowercase only, except model codes/technical references
Extract only factual technical attributes (dimensions, weight, power, pressure, material, usage, product type)
Ignore subjective descriptions

embedding_text:

max ~40 words
include product type + main specs + model
no marketing words

category:
Choose ONE only from:
produits rouges (bricks, slabs),
ciment,
fer a beton,
treillis soudes,
chimie de batiment,
colle de batiment,
systeme auto-nivelant,
coffrage vertical,
systeme echafaudage,
bois blancs,
bois de coffrage,
bois contreplaques,
isolation et etancheite,
materiel de batiment et travaux publics (BTP),
electroportatifs (outillage electrique),
quincaillerie,
equipements de chantiers,
carrelage,
systemes secs et humides

If product clearly matches one category → return normal JSON

If not relevant → ignore schema and return null:

If "on_page_details" property contains "main_product_full_content" property, try to identify the price and stock level of the product that matches the product title provided.

Be strict. Only classify with high confidence.

parameters.query:
WITH upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO pages (
        url_hash,
        competitor_id,
        url,
        normalized_url,
        recent_content_hash,
        page_type,
        page_metadata,
        technical_metadata,
        last_success_at,
        last_failure_at,
        last_error
    )
    VALUES (
        $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb,
        $9,
        $10,
        $11
    )
    ON CONFLICT (url_hash)
    DO UPDATE SET
        competitor_id = EXCLUDED.competitor_id,
        url = EXCLUDED.url,
        normalized_url = EXCLUDED.normalized_url,
        page_type = EXCLUDED.page_type,
        page_metadata = EXCLUDED.page_metadata,
        technical_metadata = EXCLUDED.technical_metadata,
        recent_content_hash = EXCLUDED.recent_content_hash,
        last_success_at = EXCLUDED.last_success_at,
        last_failure_at = $10,
        last_error = $11
    WHERE pages.recent_content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.recent_content_hash
    RETURNING url_hash, 'changed' AS action
)

SELECT * FROM upsert

UNION ALL

SELECT $1, 'no_change'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upsert);
